contextBand.title: What ICT and Marketing professionals need to know about the 491
contextBand.body: Unlike the 190, the 491 requires you to be currently employed in skilled work for a regional Victoria employer - this is mandatory for nomination, not optional. If you are not already working in regional Victoria (Geelong, Ballarat, Bendigo or similar), you are not eligible for Victorian 491 nomination from an onshore position. The January 2026 round issued approximately 80% of invitations to onshore applicants already living and working in Victoria. Offshore applicants are eligible but face significantly more competition. Additionally, the national 491 allocation was reduced 23% in 2025-26, making competition tighter than in prior years. We assess your realistic prospects at your free consultation - if the 491 is not viable for your current situation, we map the 190, 189, or employer-sponsored pathway instead.
